notes: Echo Base Operations deck with no objective. Starting cards as posted under Starting: '1st marker', 'marker', The Signal, A New Secret Base; these count toward the 60 (total 60).

Posted '1st marker' dested the Light Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker). The second starting card is posted only as 'marker' and is kept as written (UNKNOWN) because any Hoth marker site could fit.
Quantities are posted in brackets (e.g. 'X-wing[12]', 'Organized Attack[4]').
Posted 'ghhk/Out Of Nowhere' dested Houjix & Out Of Nowhere, the only combo card with Out Of Nowhere (Ghhhk's combo partner is Dark).

Posted 'X-wing cannon' dested X-wing Laser Cannon; 'Coralag' Corulag; 'Kiffex' the Light Jabba's Palace Kiffex; 'Hoth' the Light Hoth system; 'EPP Luke' Luke With Lightsaber; 'Lando In Falcon' Lando In Millennium Falcon; 'Out of commision transmision terminat' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated.
The strategy opens 'Crap i forgot ice storm'; Ice Storm is not in the list as posted.
The description claims an 8-3 tournament record but names no event.
